svg.text: Back-feed is blocked: D1/D7 point VBUS -> VCC_5V, so 5 V injected on J1/21 cannot reach either USB host.
Both cables may be plugged at once — devkit USB stays free for flashing.
FocusDock — Power Architecture & the 5 V Path
USB-only power · solid = exists today · red dashed = required change
Current budget — what fits through the devkit
Logic level — VIH = 0.7 × VDD, ESP32 drives 3.3 V
Sources: Espressif ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 schematic v1.1 · WS2812B datasheet · 1N5819HW-7-F datasheet (Diodes Inc.)
